title: VetClaw Skill Frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter of a VetClaw SKILL.md file. `name` and `description` are required; the remaining fields are optional provenance metadata that contributors are encouraged to add over time.

name.description: kebab-case identifier; must match the containing folder name.

description.description: One-line description used for agent skill matching.

version.description: Optional semantic version of the skill.

last_reviewed.description: Optional ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the most recent clinical review.

reviewer.description: Optional name, credential, or handle of the reviewer.

evidence_tier.description: Optional evidence tier for the skill's primary clinical claims.

species.description: Optional list of species the skill applies to (e.g. dog, cat, horse).

sources.description: Optional list of citable references (textbooks, guidelines, databases) supporting the skill.
